The '''Floating Palace''' was a palace on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carnovia]] that served as the headquarters of the [[Vermilic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]]. The palace was located at the center of a large lake surrounded by shallow [[Water/Legends|water]] and [[Carnovian eel]] pens. It housed a number of underwater dungeons where [[Minalod]], the Vermilic leader, housed his prisoners.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
